open_prs.title: Optimize terminal resizing, tmux capture throughput and exact Screen attachment
open_prs.body:
## Why

Rapid terminal layout changes queued intermediate transport sizes, large native tmux workspaces captured each pane in a separate synchronous command group, and Screen attachment could truncate unsupported names into a different selectable target.

## Changes

- Coalesce ordinary terminal and native tmux resizing to one in-flight request plus the latest pending dimensions. Use xterm callback dimensions, retain the final size during reversals, and revoke stale work when a session is replaced or disconnected.
- Capture native tmux panes in groups of up to eight: a controlled 20-pane fixture now uses three capture writes; 64 panes require at most eight groups. Preserve ordered replies, atomic workspace publication, per-pane hard deadlines and the existing admission bound. Queued input does not time out behind a progressing capture.
- Preserve complete Screen identifiers, including trailing tabs, by removing exactly the producer's single separators. Reject incomplete or contradictory listings, duplicate IDs and competing prefixes before attachment.
- Add focused concurrency, deadline, resize-reversal and actual POSIX shell regressions, plus a serial validation option for constrained hosts.

## Integration

The final saved cutoff contains **46 branch heads and 159 PR heads (205 references)**. Every reference is an actual ancestor of the integrated branch, including latest main at that cutoff, the newer terminal/Zotero work and original squash-equivalent PR histories.

Incoming ODS tab colours exposed an XLSX save failure when a sheet also contained a picture. The regression fails before the correction; the canonical fix is saved at [Quds 4fadcc68](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/quds_office_suite/commit/4fadcc68d52d51e72e8d782765a0dd5086b982c6) and vendored exactly. All **2,411 managed Office files** verify. Root dependency declarations, lockfile and Flutter pin are unchanged from the initial baseline.

## Local validation

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Complete terminal/SSH/tmux cohort | **1,075 passed, 2 platform skips**, 85 files |
| Actual loopback OpenSSH | **22 passed, 3 explicit skips**, 4 files |
| Final vendored ODS/Zotero engine cohort | **209 passed**, no skips or failures |
| Screen tab-boundary shell regressions | **32 passed**; 12 fail against the preceding implementation |
| Static analysis | **164 Dart files**, no errors or warnings; three existing informational lints |
| Formatting | **164 Dart files**, zero changes |
| Production-widget captures | **2 tests passed**, nine desktop/320×320 captures |
| Full optimized web release | **Passed in 219.762 seconds**, standard **O4/minification** retained |

All **5,556 watched source files** match the frozen committed source across all seven accepted phases. The final verification binds commands and suite counts, immutable source paths/blobs/modes, the successful build attempt, artifact checksum, and the exact pinned SDK restoration. The release embeds `1.3.4+28` and source-equivalent build commit `e4c559af`; accepted application source is `047adfb9`.

[Complete commands, logs, integration proof and source verification](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/852f009cadb153cfcb0799c527fdd78364a2df8d/docs/validation/terminal-session-optimization-20261116/README.md). Earlier development and resource failures are preserved separately from accepted results.

## Qualification limits

- macOS shell and Windows ConPTY cases need their respective hosts. Two optional live-SSH PTY cases were not enabled here.
- Unix-socket creation is rejected by this host. The actual Unix-agent test and tmux daemon probe remain unqualified; Screen regressions exercise the real shell resolver against controlled listings.
- Widget captures and release compilation do not constitute browser-runtime or packaged-platform acceptance. The capture fonts lack Chinese fallback glyphs; the image review records this and the limits of visual accessibility checks.

Implementation and evidence were saved incrementally to this remote branch. New checkpoints carry `[skip ci]`. **No GitHub Actions jobs were queried, awaited or rerun.**

<details>
<summary>Earlier optimization checkpoint and its historical qualification</summary>

CrispCloud consumes the shared Quds Zotero implementation. It needs the verified metadata batching and native-session scaling improvements while retaining the recent Office and terminal work.

open_prs.title: Improve Office Zotero workflow and reconcile recent terminal work [skip ci]
open_prs.body:
## Why

The shared Zotero workflow needed smoother first-use catalog insertion, protected mixed citation formatting and note labels that agree with document order. This imports the qualified Quds continuation from [Quds PR #50](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/quds_office_suite/pull/50) and preserves all incoming work observed before the final reconciliation cutoff.

## Changes

- Make **Insert with Zotero…** the primary native catalog action. A fresh document chooses native preferences and then opens the seeded picker in one staged transaction and undo step.
- Display the saved style, language and citation placement.
- Preserve supported mixed character formatting and complete linked field packets through editing, copy/paste, paragraph splitting, native conversion and DOCX roundtrip.
- Render note labels from body order with supported numbering preferences and custom marks.
- Merge the newly discovered terminal PR #160 at **49d63f78d0b854ba76289dba69fdb6584f8a1260**, preserving both parents. Its forwarding/output-trigger work is qualified locally; no terminal production/test changes were needed.
- Retain the standalone legacy parser source and exact managed-file guard.

## Local validation

**1,138 selected unit/widget tests passed:** 579 canonical engine/Word, 195 shared editor, 16 actual Studio transport, 37 actual CrispCloud host, 85 incoming ODS integration and 226 incoming terminal tests.

Strict analysis and formatting passed for the 32 changed canonical Dart targets and eight host targets. The host measured 1,595 unchanged source files. Both vendor guards verified **2,399 entries: 542 Quds + 1,857 unchanged parser files**. Production dependency constraints were unchanged.

Separately, **six real disposable-loopback SSH tests** and **three shell smoke scenarios** passed; one optional PTY case was explicitly skipped. The initial SOCKS timeout during concurrent heavy qualification, the unchanged diagnostic retry and final full pass are all preserved. No timeout or test was weakened.

Real desktop Zotero acceptance passed through the actual shared client, Word adapter and Studio transport: local catalog browsing, native style selection/refresh producing **Ebd.** and **Ebd., 34.**, and the fresh-document preferences-to-seeded-picker insertion sequence. DOCX save/reopen preserves the linked citation, locator, placement, mixed italics and style. Full compiled applications and Microsoft Word/LibreOffice interoperability are separate acceptance steps.

- [Host evidence and reproduction](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/zotero-support-20261116/docs/validation/zotero-continuation-20261116/README.md)
- [Actual host receipt](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/zotero-support-20261116/docs/validation/zotero-continuation-20261116/final/host-validation-receipt.json)
- [Terminal evidence](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/zotero-support-20261116/docs/validation/zotero-continuation-20261116/terminal-integration/README.md)
- [Canonical and native Zotero evidence](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/quds_office_suite/tree/codex/zotero-support-20261116/docs/validation/zotero-continuation-20261116)
- [User guide](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/zotero-support-20261116/docs/zotero.md)

Final CrispCloud checkpoint: **cf442dd2aab29211ab8b9c80f0767373b91a3c94**, pinning final Quds **b24718cc1468c34f494805eb7fb433a87f565503**. The [delivery proof](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/zotero-support-20261116/docs/validation/zotero-continuation-20261116/delivery-source-proof.json) verifies every recorded canonical, host and terminal input, unchanged managed inventory, and zero managed-file writes/deletions for the final pin. Both vendor guards passed again against that pin.

## Source reconciliation and delivery

Both earlier Zotero PRs (#149 here and Quds #47) were merged before this continuation. Initial integration preceded feature work. The final snapshot at **2026-11-16 05:17:13 UTC** accounts for 62 branch heads and 199 PR heads; all 259 external refs are ancestors after the terminal merge, with the two continuation refs listed separately.

Incremental remote checkpoints use `[skip ci]`. **No GitHub Actions were queried, polled, awaited or rerun.** The manifest records the exact immutable Quds pin; final documentation-only pins preserve the qualified implementation.

## Remaining boundaries

Small caps and bibliography paragraph layout require reviewed simplification; page-based note restarts/unsupported formats use source-ID fallback. Active ODT transfer is absent. Native locator-popup editing remains unverified: the preserved bounded input-automation attempt timed out, while accepting the preselected source/page 12 passed. Full native builds, private accounts/OS-keychain behavior and Word/LibreOffice interoperability remain unverified. Unsupported stories, protected/ambiguous fields and unsafe note conversions refuse processing.

open_prs.title: Add workspace recovery, shared SSH shells and native tmux panes
open_prs.body:
## Why

Users need to reopen their terminal workspace without rebuilding tabs and split panes by hand. This continuation adds opt-in automatic workspace recovery and clear actions for starting recovered sessions, while preserving the earlier shared SSH shells, native tmux panes, agents, forwarding and output-trigger work.

## What changes

- **Terminal layout → Session recovery** remembers up to eight tabs, names/order, nested split geometry, active pane, font sizes and sanitized SSH/jump/agent/tmux/Screen destinations.
- **Remember terminal workspace** and **Relaunch local shells** both default off. Local relaunch starts fresh local sessions; recovered SSH destinations retain explicit authentication and host-key checks.
- Idle panes show **Ready to start a session** with **Start local shell**, **Start built-in shell** or **Reconnect SSH**. Saved SSH identity is visible in the idle pane header.
- One bounded, versioned preference record preserves settings and the workspace together. Ordered ownership handoff, lifecycle flushes, read timeouts, retry, confirmed Forget and stale-callback guards cover remounts and storage failures.
- Commands, output, credentials, previous working directories, filesystem grants, process state, shared-route ownership and broadcast membership are excluded from recovery. Controls are translated into the eight existing non-English locales.
- Incoming changes coalesce terminal/tmux resizes, preserve final geometry through rapid reversals, batch pane captures in groups of up to eight, enforce tmux reply deadlines and harden exact GNU Screen attachment.

## Incoming integration

Implementation is frozen at **`fdc262e112aa29dd1e60a76cff9a2dfb5f2d7b4f`**. The reviewed snapshot at **10:43:14 UTC on 16 November 2026** contains **46 branch heads and 159 PR heads**; all **205 references are actual ancestors**. The integration retains original PR heads #167–#169 and main `b9772e1a`, including Zotero optimizations and ODS tab colors, after the earlier PR #164–#166 reconciliation.

The Office pin is **`18c76e886623ae3be9a41addd80e7f6837c2d3b0`** with all **2,411 managed entries**, including all previous 2,409 paths. Exact canonical/legacy blob and mode identities, local SHA-256 checks, the clean merge preview and evidence-preservation proof are recorded.

## Local validation

| Check | Result on the frozen integrated source |
|---|---|
| Targeted combined regressions | **701 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed across 44 suites**, 184.272 seconds |
| Recovery/idle regressions within that total | **76 passed** across four suites |
| Analysis | **175 semantic targets; 0 errors, 0 warnings, 3 pre-existing style infos** |
| Formatting | All **175 original files**, zero changes |
| Vendor provenance | **2,411 Office entries**, **96 SSH upstream files**, four reviewed patches |
| Visual inspection | **Five saved production-widget captures**: desktop and 320×320; all inspected |
| Source identity | All **5,673 watched inputs** identical across 12 inventories/six phases; **5,664 tracked inputs** match frozen blobs and modes |
| Standard full application web release | **Did not complete**: dart2js was externally killed by signal 9; no release JavaScript artifact |

The runtime cohort uses **Flutter 3.47.8 / Dart 3.13.7**, the unchanged production graph and explicit per-command settings `FLUTTER_NATIVE_ASSETS=false FLUTTER_DART_DATA_ASSETS=true`. Data hooks remain enabled; native code assets are omitted. Seven engine test adapters change only the test-framework import and declared fixture paths, with byte-for-byte reversal and preserved assertions. Three adapters are also used for analysis; formatting checks the originals. The single skip is the existing macOS-only real-PTY test.

The final normal web attempt used standard O4/minification, normal web hooks and a 4,096 MB compiler heap with both isolated-test overrides absent. It ended after 84.263 seconds including verification. There was no Dart source diagnostic; the SIGKILL cause is not established. Source identity and exact SDK binary/mode restoration passed independently. Two failed attempts on the earlier source are retained separately.

## Acceptance boundaries

This PR remains a **draft**. Normal native bridges, browser runtime, packaged desktop/mobile builds and live SSH/tmux execution need their own qualification. Full web release acceptance is also outstanding. The fresh isolated checks do not reuse older full-native or live-SSH totals.

Independent OS windows, live process/scrollback/working-directory restoration, automatic SSH reconnect, persistent idle connection masters, cross-process pooling and richer trigger/coprocess automation remain open parity work.

Implementation, logs, screenshots, failures and provenance are saved incrementally with `[skip ci]`. **No GitHub Actions were queried, awaited or rerun.**

[Usage guide](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/terminal-screen-workspace/docs/terminal.md#automatic-session-recovery) · [Complete acceptance record](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/terminal-screen-workspace/docs/validation/terminal-workspace-recovery/README.md) · [Incoming ancestry proof](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/terminal-screen-workspace/docs/validation/terminal-workspace-recovery/completion-incoming/post-integration.json) · [Final source identity](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/blob/codex/terminal-screen-workspace/docs/validation/terminal-workspace-recovery/final-acceptance/final-source-verification.json)

open_prs.title: Extract a reusable native Flutter hex editor for CrispCloud
open_prs.body:
## Scope

Preserve the existing CrispCloud hex editor work in this maintained MadEdit2 fork, under `packages/madedit2_hex`.

- Persistent byte-only AVL document, immutable snapshots, undo/redo and bounded-memory search.
- Serialized nibble/byte commands, selection and clipboard handling.
- Virtualized Flutter hex/ASCII surface, navigation, toolbar and touch keypad.
- Original MIT license, explicit upstream provenance and host integration documentation.
- Standalone Linux, Windows, macOS and Chrome CI with read-only repository permissions.

The original CrispCloud checkpoint is preserved, with additional fixes for a shared 64 MiB undo/redo byte budget, stale-search cancellation, horizontal caret visibility and explicit monospace font fallbacks. The upstream desktop application is not modified. Rust, Tree-sitter and desktop application settings are not package dependencies.

## Integration

CrispCloud retains the vendored path dependency and records the fork commit and exact file fingerprints in `packages/madedit2_hex/FORK.json`. A read-only offline verification step rejects accidental drift. Application storage, account identity, staged saving and file routing remain in CrispCloud's `feature/madedit2-hex-editor` branch.

## Validation / release gates

Pinned package revision: `50d033cc70d9121819c890fe587f8b3dc4c82311`.

- All 24 standalone package tests pass locally. The fork's Linux and Windows jobs passed, including Chrome package execution on Linux.
- [CrispCloud run 42272446143](https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/actions/runs/42272446143) verified the matching source fingerprints and passed all 24 package tests on Linux, Windows and macOS.
- That application run passed 44 native tests on Ubuntu, 39 on Windows and 39 on macOS. Chrome passed 33 application tests, including all three restored editor-page tests and all eleven storage-session tests, with no skips.
- Physical-device touch/IME/accessibility, throughput and real-provider acceptance remain separate release checks. The standalone fork macOS job may remain queued; the identical package source has passed in the application macOS job above.

Application follow-up: https://github.com/CrispStrobe/CrispCloud/pull/20

This is a draft review checkpoint. Do not merge automatically.
